company_meta_description: {store} is a data-driven beauty and personal care company for Latin America, selling directly to consumers in {country}.
company_title: Latin America's data-driven beauty and personal care company.
company_lead: We make choosing beauty and personal care simpler and more trustworthy, starting in {country}.
company_gap_body: A review of 21 public skin-image datasets found that only about 2% of nearly 107,000 images recorded the phototype, that is, the skin's tone and how it reacts to the sun. Most of the datasets that state their origin come from Europe, North America and Oceania.
company_gap_source: Wen et al., The Lancet Digital Health, 2022
company_today_direct_body: eclalune.com sells beauty and personal care in {country}, organized by need and by complete routines.
company_today_service_body: We confirm every order and answer questions before delivery.
company_today_tech_body: Our catalog, orders and inventory run on technology we build ourselves.
company_contact_body: For startup programs, partnerships and press, write to us.
